subject: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles

Team — attaching draft MAP (MAP_draft_v0.3.docx). I want to run a quick internal dry run before we invite Acme for the kickoff. Goal: align on owners, evaluation criteria, and the target close timeline (internal target: 2026-08-15).

Quick asks:
- Can each of you scan the RACI section (page 2) and call out any gaps by EOD tomorrow?
- Lauren: can you confirm whether CS should lead the evaluation sessions or just support?
- Monica: can you take a pass on the stakeholder roster and add missing invitees (esp. procurement & infra folks)?
- Rishi: can you confirm if we should treat the security checklist as a separate MAP workstream?

Proposed dry run: Thu 7/3, 2:00–2:45pm PT (30min review + 15min buffer). I’ll circulate an updated file beforehand.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v0.3.docx (runbook + initial RACI).

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles

On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — attaching draft MAP (MAP_draft_v0.3.docx). I want to run a quick internal dry run before we invite Acme for the kickoff.

Thanks Aditya — quick reads below. Mostly small edits but a couple of asks: 
- Evaluation sessions: I recommend CS lead the demo/eval logistics (scheduling, prompt sets, metric capture) and Product (me) lead the success criteria discussion. I’ll note that in the RACI but leave the final owner as "Product/CS" until we land on dates.
- Meeting length: 45 minutes for the dry run might be tight if we walk the full MAP. Suggest 45–60 min so we can simulate handoffs.
- Legal: we should pre-alert Legal that procurement may bring contract redlines on day 1. SooJin, can you confirm if Legal needs a separate pre-read?

I’ll attach a small worksheet with suggested evaluation criteria (evaluation_criteria.xlsx).

—Lauren
Director, Product & GTM Operations
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles

Thanks — I reviewed the RACI and added comments in the doc (page 2). High-level:
- Switch from single-word "Owner" to two columns: "Lead" and "Contributor" — reduces confusion when multiple parties share responsibility.
- Added two missing Acme stakeholders: "Kate Andrews (Head of ML infra)" and "Procurement Ops (procurement@acme.com)". I put Kate on the invite list but recommend we keep Procurement out of the first eval session; bring them in during the contract/terms discussion.
- Suggested internal dry run slot: Fri 7/3 16:00–17:00 PT (45 min) — I booked a tentative calendar block (link below).

Tentative calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/7b2f3d-map-dryrun

I’ll incorporate Lauren’s evaluation workbook into the MAP doc as an appendix so we have a single source of truth.

-Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles

Team — thanks for the quick turns. I’ve merged comments and uploaded MAP_draft_v0.4-tracked.docx to the Drive folder. Key updates:
- RACI changed to Lead / Contributor per Monica.
- Evaluation appendix added (Lauren’s workbook).
- Meeting flow tightened to 40 minutes for dry run (30 + 10 buffer).

Ask: please review v0.4 and flag any blockers by EOD today (7/3) so I can finalize and invite Acme next week. If no blockers, I’ll mark the doc as final and prepare the external invite with agenda + outcomes.

Attachment: MAP_draft_v0.4-tracked.docx (Drive link in thread).

-Aditya

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff runbook — dry run & roles

Looks good to me — no major blockers. A couple of notes: 
1) Security checklist: recommend we treat Security as its own workstream (owner: Infra/Security) and include a short "security health" slot in the kickoff (5–7 min). I can draft the checklist items if you want.
2) Legal pre-read: SooJin, if Legal can sign off on the sensitive data handling section by next Tuesday, that will unblock procurement conversations.

If those two items are covered, I’m comfortable with finalizing and inviting Acme.

-Rishi
Head of Solutions Architecture
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, SooJin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — dry run completed; external invite next steps

Kate / Acme team — looping you in early. Internal dry run is complete and we have a finalized MAP (attached: MAP_final_v1.0.pdf). High level:
- Objective of kickoff: align on evaluation plan (tech fit + performance), scope acceptance criteria, and a proposed close timeline (Redwood target: 2026-08-15).
- Internal assignments (leads):
  • Technical evaluation logistics — Monica Patel (Solutions)
  • Evaluation criteria & success metrics — Lauren Bishop (Product)
  • Security checklist/workstream — Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Architecture)
  • Contract & procurement coordination — Aditya Rao (Sales) + Legal (SooJin Lee) as needed

Proposed next steps for Acme:
1) Please confirm availability for a 60-min kickoff week of 7/13.
2) Share attendee list (recommended: ML infra, Platform, Procurement).
3) If possible, send any eval-relevant docs (current infra, token budgets) ahead of the kickoff.

Attachments: MAP_final_v1.0.pdf (single-file MAP with agenda & RACI). Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B-map-acme/overview

Thanks all — I’ll create the formal calendar invite once Kate confirms.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
